<thought>Only carbon shows a clear isotopic pattern: a series of peaks spaced by ~1 Da with intensities decreasing in a binomial fashion (≈8 % for +1, 0.5 % for +2, etc.), matching the natural 13C/12C distribution for a molecule containing ~10 carbons. No other element exhibits a distinctive pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
